oracle.method: finite-sample F critical values by numerical integration
oracle.independence_basis: F(1,n-2) 0.95 critical values from two different stdlib-only computations that must agree to 1e-9: Simpson integration of the Student t density with bisection on the 0.975 quantile, and Lentz's continued fraction for the regularized incomplete beta with bisection on x^2. Neither computation uses Antecedent's incomplete-beta, F quantile or generators; the two routes are mathematically distinct quadrature and continued-fraction evaluations. The t-squared-equals-F identity for one numerator degree of freedom is the shared theorem.
asserted_outputs: finite F critical value for n=150 (non-ignored role/diagnostic test)
finite F critical values for n=150,300,600 (ignored calibration measurement test only)
oracle.historical_exposure: The original harness was not retained; this replacement was written during this review from the README's stated method plus an independent continued-fraction cross-check. No product source was consulted.
